events.title: Freddie Mercury Tribute
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the world lost legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable talent of Freddie Mercury, 35 years since his passing. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy – truly one of a kind.

events.title: The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. Still sounds as fresh and innovative now as it did then, doesn't it?

events.title: John Lennon Tribute
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the music world mourned the tragic loss of John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 this year. His message of peace and love resonates as strongly today as ever.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie at 80
angles.copy: The Starman would have turned 80 today. Forever pushing boundaries, forever an icon. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Celebrating the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 92 today.

angles.name: The King's Birthday
angles.copy: Long live the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today. Still shaking up the airwaves.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary guitarist of Led Zeppelin, Jimmy Page.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Jimmy Page
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the maestro, Jimmy Page. The riff-master general himself!

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Celebrating the 82nd birthday of the iconic British singer, Sir Rod Stewart.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rod
angles.copy: Raise a glass for Sir Rod Stewart, who turns 82 today! Still got it, hasn't he?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Suggs
angles.copy: It's the one and only Suggs' 66th birthday! Bet he's having a good time, all the time.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the soulful British singer, Paul Young.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Paul Young
angles.copy: Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday today. We'll be playing some of his classics to mark the occasion!

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Happy 81st birthday to the legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Dolly
angles.copy: What a woman! Dolly Parton turns 81 today. Still working 9 to 5 and looking fabulous!

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That frontman, Gary Barlow.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Gary
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! What's your favourite Take That track or solo hit?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Celebrating the 77th birthday of the Grammy-winning British singer, Billy Ocean.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Billy Ocean
angles.copy: Get out of my dreams and into my car... and wish Billy Ocean a very happy 77th birthday!

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame's first induction
events.blurb: The first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place on this day in 1989, honouring rock pioneers.

angles.name: Rock Hall Firsts
angles.copy: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its first induction. Who do you think was the most deserving of those early inductees?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Mark Owen
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 55th birthday to the eternally youthful Mark Owen! Still got those moves!

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their iconic final live performance on the Apple Corps rooftop.

angles.name: Rooftop Gig
angles.copy: It's 58 years since The Beatles played their legendary rooftop concert. What an iconic way to say goodbye to live performing!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary drummer and singer, Phil Collins.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Phil Collins
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 76th birthday to the one and only Phil Collins! What's your go-to Genesis or solo track?

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Happy 67th birthday to the quintessential British actor, Hugh Grant.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Hugh Grant
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to Hugh Grant! From bumbling rom-com hero to charming rogue, he's still got that undeniable British charm.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 46th birthday to the pop superstar, Justin Timberlake.

angles.name: Happy Birthday JT
angles.copy: The multi-talented Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today! What's your favourite JT banger?

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the beloved British acting legend, Sir David Jason.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Del Boy
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Sir David Jason turns 87 today. A true national treasure. What's your favourite Del Boy moment?

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1959, rock and roll legends Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash.

angles.name: Remembering The Day The Music Died
angles.copy: Remembering the tragic 'Day The Music Died' in 1959, when we lost Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper. Their music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Happy 61st birthday to the pop icon and internet legend, Rick Astley.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rick Astley
angles.copy: Never gonna give him up! Rick Astley turns 61 today. Still touring and still sounding fantastic.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Remembering the reggae legend Bob Marley, who would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Bob Marley Tribute
angles.copy: The undisputed King of Reggae, Bob Marley, would have been 82 today. His music and message of peace continue to inspire.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Happy 85th birthday to the legendary singer-songwriter, Carole King.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Carole King
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King. A true songwriting genius!

events.title: Whitney Houston Tribute
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable voice of Whitney Houston, who passed away on this day in 2012, and would have been 64.

angles.name: Remembering Whitney
angles.copy: Eleven years since we lost the voice of a generation, Whitney Houston. Her incredible talent is still sorely missed.

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, millions of hearts were broken as Take That announced their split.

angles.name: Take That Breakup
angles.copy: Twenty-six years ago today, Take That announced their split, leaving a generation in tears. Thankfully, they came back!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell, the distinctive voice of UB40.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Ali Campbell
angles.copy: Red, Red Wine... and a happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell of UB40! Still bringing those reggae vibes.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Happy 36th birthday to the global superstar singer-songwriter, Ed Sheeran.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Ed Sheeran
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 36th birthday to Suffolk's finest, Ed Sheeran! What's your favourite track from the ginger genius?

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: Remembering George Harrison, who would have celebrated his 84th birthday today.

angles.name: George Harrison Tribute
angles.copy: The quiet Beatle, George Harrison, would have been 84 today. His incredible songwriting legacy lives on.
